packs.name: FL LUA Effects
packs.author: FL LUA
packs.description: Soft Clipper, Maximizer, Hyper Chorus, Waveshaper, Overdrive, Delay Bank and Pitcher: mastering, character and vocal tools.

plugins.name: Soft Clipper
plugins.description: Drive into a smooth clipper: tanh, cubic, arctan or hard-knee curve, with oversampling

plugins.name: Maximizer
plugins.description: One-knob three-band loudness maximizer with a look-ahead limiter (reports its latency)

plugins.name: Hyper Chorus
plugins.description: Up to eight modulated delay voices spread across the stereo field

plugins.name: Waveshaper
plugins.description: Eight transfer curves: soft, hard, fold, sine fold, diode, Chebyshev 3 and 5, steps

plugins.name: Overdrive
plugins.description: Tube, crunch or fuzz with a focus pre-filter, asymmetry, tone and low cut

plugins.name: Delay Bank
plugins.description: Four delay taps, each with its own time, level, pan, feedback and damping; tempo-synced or free

plugins.name: Pitcher
plugins.description: Monophonic pitch corrector: snaps a voice or lead to a scale (reports its latency)

packs.name: FL LUA Synths
packs.author: FL LUA
packs.description: Acid Bass, Tri-Osc, Chip and Additive: four generators for basses, leads, game sounds and evolving pads.

plugins.name: Acid Bass
plugins.description: Monophonic bass with a resonant ladder filter, accent (velocity above 80%) and slide (overlap two notes)

plugins.name: Tri-Osc
plugins.description: Three oscillators with sync, ring modulation and FM, a multimode filter and two envelopes

plugins.name: Chip
plugins.description: Console-style pulse, triangle and noise voices with arpeggio, sweep, vibrato and bit reduction

plugins.name: Additive
plugins.description: Up to 64 partials with tilt, odd/even balance, a formant, inharmonicity and a morph between two spectra
